title: Vendor risk review
description: One review of a third-party relationship: what the vendor provides, what data and access it has, how critical it is, the inherent and residual risk, the assessments performed, findings and their remediation, the review cadence and the approval decision. Informed by the US interagency guidance on third-party relationships (OCC Bulletin 2023-17), NIST SP 800-161 Rev. 1 and ISO/IEC 27036.

$schema.title: Schema
$schema.description: The $id of this schema, so readers can tell what the record is.

schemaVersion.title: Schema version
schemaVersion.description: The version of this format the record follows.

id.description: This review's identifier, unique within the system that created it.

externalIds.title: External identifiers
externalIds.description: Ids for this review in other systems (GRC tool, procurement, contract repository).

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed.

relationshipOwner.description: The person accountable for the relationship inside the organization.

lifecycleStage.title: Lifecycle stage
lifecycleStage.description: Where the relationship is in the third-party risk life cycle: planning, due-diligence (before contract), contract-negotiation, ongoing-monitoring or termination.

services.title: Services
services.description: What the vendor provides under the relationship.

items.title: Service
items.description: One service or product the vendor provides.

description.title: Description
description.description: What the service does for the organization.

supportsCriticalActivity.title: Supports a critical activity
supportsCriticalActivity.description: Whether the service supports an activity whose failure would significantly harm the organization or its customers.

endDate.description: When the service ends or ended.

contractRef.title: Contract reference
contractRef.description: The contract or order that covers the service.

annualSpend.description: Expected or actual spend per year.

dataCategories.title: Data categories
dataCategories.description: The kinds of data the vendor stores, processes or can reach. Use none, on its own, when it has no access to the organization's data.

access.title: Access
access.description: How the vendor reaches the organization's systems and data.

systemAccess.title: System access
systemAccess.description: The highest level of access the vendor has to the organization's systems: none, read, read-write or administrative.

hostsData.title: Hosts data
hostsData.description: Whether the vendor stores the organization's data on infrastructure it controls.

dataLocations.title: Data locations
dataLocations.description: Countries where the vendor stores or processes the data.

subcontractors.title: Subcontractors
subcontractors.description: The vendor's own suppliers that touch the service or data (fourth parties).

service.title: Service
service.description: What the subcontractor does for the vendor.

criticality.title: Criticality
criticality.description: How much the organization depends on the relationship: low, moderate, high or critical. Critical relationships support critical activities.

criticalityRationale.title: Criticality rationale
criticalityRationale.description: Why the relationship has that criticality.

inherentRisk.description: Risk before the vendor's and the organization's controls are taken into account.

riskDomains.title: Risk by domain
riskDomains.description: Inherent and residual risk for each risk domain that was assessed.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: What drives the rating, including controls that reduce it.

assessments.title: Assessments
assessments.description: Due-diligence and monitoring activities performed for this review.

id.description: Identifier for this item, unique within the record.

type.title: Type
type.description: questionnaire, document-review, independent-report-review (for example a SOC report or certificate), onsite-visit, remote-assessment, financial-review, penetration-test-review, continuous-monitoring or other.

evidenceName.title: Evidence name
evidenceName.description: The report, certificate or questionnaire reviewed, as named by its issuer, for example 'SOC 2 Type II report' or 'ISO/IEC 27001 certificate'.

periodStart.description: Start of the period the evidence covers.

periodEnd.description: End of the period the evidence covers.

attachmentIds.description: Ids of related entries in the record's attachments.

findings.title: Findings
findings.description: Issues found during the review and what is being done about them.

reviewCadence.title: Review cadence
reviewCadence.description: How often the relationship is reviewed, and when the next review is due.

frequency.title: Frequency
frequency.description: monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual, biennial or event-driven.

lastReviewedOn.description: When the last review was completed.

nextReviewDue.description: When the next scheduled review is due.

triggers.title: Event triggers
triggers.description: Events that prompt a review outside the schedule, for example a breach notice, change of control or material service change.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: approved, approved-with-conditions, rejected, deferred or terminate-relationship.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: Sign-offs on the decision, in order.

capacity.title: Capacity
capacity.description: The role in which the person approves, for example business owner, CISO, third-party risk committee.

status.description: draft, in-review, pending-approval, approved, rejected or closed.

statusHistory.title: Status history
statusHistory.description: Every status the record has had, oldest first, each one of the values of status.

status.description: The status the record moved to, one of this format's status values.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Files that belong to the review: reports, questionnaires, contracts.

auditTrail.title: Audit trail
auditTrail.description: Recorded actions on the review, oldest first.

extensions.description: Local fields this format doesn't define, namespaced as <namespace>:<field>.

status.title: Status
status.description: The status values of this format.

riskDomain.title: Risk domain
riskDomain.description: information-security, privacy, operational-resilience, business-continuity, financial, compliance, legal, reputational, concentration, strategic, geographic or environmental-social.

riskRating.title: Risk rating
riskRating.description: An overall risk rating with the reasoning behind it.

level.description: The overall level: low, moderate, high or critical.

score.title: Score
score.description: A numeric score on the organization's own scale, if it uses one.

method.title: Method
method.description: The scoring method or model used.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Why the rating is what it is.

finding.title: Finding
finding.description: An issue found during the review.

id.description: Identifier for the finding, unique within the review.

description.title: Description
description.description: What was found and why it matters.

assessmentId.description: The assessment that raised the finding.

status.title: Status
status.description: open, remediation-planned, in-remediation, remediated, risk-accepted or closed.

remediation.title: Remediation
remediation.description: The plan to fix the issue.

riskAcceptance.title: Risk acceptance
riskAcceptance.description: A documented decision to accept the risk instead of fixing it. Required when status is risk-accepted.

rationale.title: Rationale
rationale.description: Why the risk is accepted, and any compensating controls.
